tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (cha)༄༅/ /so thar gyi bshags sdom zhi gnas gso sbyong dang 'brel pa nyes ltung dag byed gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /so byang sngags gsum
(cha)༄༅/ /so thar gyi bshags sdom zhi gnas gso sbyong dang 'brel pa nyes ltung dag byed gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /so byang sngags gsum

tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// so thar gyi bshags sdom zhi gnas gso sbyong dang 'brel pa nyes ltung dag byed gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// so byang sngags gsum gyi bshags tshig khyad par can no// ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs kyi rdul dri ma med pa la mgo bos rab tu gtugs te gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lhang nge ba// mgon po shākya seng ge dgongs su gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ma lus dang*// byang chub sems dang nyan rang dge 'dun tshogs// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed bzhugs pa yi// 'phags pa rnams kyang bdag la dgongs su gsol// kun mkhyen thar pa'i lam ston shākya'i rgyal// ston dang bstan pa gnyis gyur chos 'dul ba// skyes bu zung bzhi tshogs mchog dge 'dun gyi// rjes su slob nas so thar ris brgyad po'i// spang 'jug bslab bya rgyud la 'byor pa dang*// bcas 'gal nyes ltung byang bar byin gyis rlobs// ltung dang 'byung dang de ldang nges par 'byung*// gang zag bcas dang rab dbyer rnam nges pa'i// chos 'dul ma thos spang blang ma shes dang*// bslab la ma gus shes kyang bag med dbang*// nyon mongs mang bas tshul bzhin bsgrub ma nus// ltung ba'i sgo bzhir zhugs pa mthol lo bshags// thog mar nges 'byung bsam pas ma zin dang*// bar du rtog dpyod ma zhugs bsrung sdom 'chal// tha ma tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin pas// bslab pa dri bcas gyur pa mthol lo bshags// mi mthun sems skyes thob byung sems ma skyes// skye ba'i gegs rnams shes bzhin dang du blangs// log lta chos spangs bslab pa spang 'dod sogs// sdom pa btang yang dus mtshams ngo ma shes// blangs la ma thob nyes rnams mthol lo bshags// skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dgag dang bsgrub phyogs drug

/cha mthun lnga dang bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad// dge bsnyen rtsa bzhi chang lnga dge tshul gyi// pham 'dra bshags bya'i nyes byas nyams gsum sogs// bslab tshigs snga mar 'gal rnams mthol lo bshags// kha skong chos dang mi ldan las gral zhugs// ma 'dus 'dus pa phyir zlog mi mthun skyed// brtan mkhas ma tshang mkhan po'i bya ba byas// gnas pa slob mar nad g.yog 'gyod bsal dang*// sdig lta spong sogs bu yi 'du shes kyis// snying nas phan pa ma btags mthol lo bshags// mkhan slob gsang ston gnas klog slob dpon lngar// ston pa'i 'du shes ma bzhag tshul 'chal dang*// mnyam 'grogs spang blang slob pa'i gnas ma bsten// bsnyen par rdzogs nas bcu drug lo lon kyang*// 'dul ba'i sde snod mi shes byis pa dang*// tshul 'chal sre da lta bur gyur bzhin du// dge 'dun spyi yi dkor spyod nan tur gyi// chad las dang du ma blangs mthol lo bshags// rma yi sgo gsum dag la mi tshangs spyod// yul dus rin thang tshang ba ma byin blangs// mi ru chags dang mi srog bsam bzhin gcod// mngon shes bzang brdzu mi chos bla ma'i rdzun// gzhi bsam sbyor ba mthar thug tshang ba yis// 'di bzhi gang rung gcig spyod 'chab bcas pas// dge slong sdom pa rtsad nas gcod 'gyur te// chu shing rul pa ji bzhin dge 'dun gyi// gral la mi dbang bzhin tu phyin pa dang*// yan lag ma tshang sbom po lci yang sogs// phas pham ltung bas gos pa mthol lo bshags// bsgrod min gnas su khu ba 'byin pa dang*// chags pas bud med lus kyi cha shas 'dzin// 'khrig tshig rjen smra 'khrig pa'i bsnyen bkur sngags// pho mo phan tshun smyan byas 'dus te 'phrad// rang don tshad lhag khang pa khang chen brtsigs// brjod gzhi med dang snyad ka bag tsam la// brten nas dge slong skur btab dge 'dun dbyen// dbyen de'i rjes phyogs bslab pa dang 'gal pas// khyim sun 'byin tshe skrod byed la bsnyon pa// ltung byung bskul tshe bka' blo mi bde rnams// gang spyod sdom pa'i lhag las ma lus kyang*// ngo tsha med pas spo mgu ma spyad pa// lhag ltung bcu gsum phog pa mthol lo bshags// rang gi gos lhag zhag bcu 'das par 'chang*// chos gos dang bral zhag gcig lon pa dang*// gos rgyu zla gcig 'jog dang dge slong mar// chos gos 'khrur 'dug de las gos rgyu len// nye du min pa'i khyim par gos rgyu slong*// ster na stod g.yogs smad g.yogs lhag por len// rang la ster bsam chos gos gnas dpags pa// rin dang khru tshad kyis slong brtags dran slong*// gos rin rin chen bskur ba len rnams dang*// srin bal nang tshangs can gyi mal stan byed// dkon sar bal nag 'ba' zhig bting dang stan// cha gnyis lhag byed lo drug ma song bar// stan gsar sgrub dang bde gshegs mtho gang pa'i// rnying pas ma glan gding ba gsar pa bting*// bal nag rnyed nas dpag tshad gsum mthar khyer// dge slong ma la bal 'khru rmel bcug dang*// gser dngul len dang tshong 'bun mngon tshan can// ched du tshong byed lhung bzed byin ma brlabs// zhag bcu 'das 'chang lhung bzed zung 'chang ba// gla rngan med par 'thags 'jug thags rgya bskyed// dge slong gos byin slar phrogs brtad byung gos// sbyin dus bshad las snga bar bdag gir byas// dgon par 'jigs bcas gos bral zhag bdun 'das// ras chen dgag dbye zin kyang zla phyed 'das// dge 'dun bsngos pa'i rnyed pa bdag tu bzung*// sman bzhi dus las 'das par gsog 'jog ste// gang la ltung byung dngos po de spangs pas// ma bcos rnam smin ngan 'gror ltung byed pa'i// spangs ltung sum cus gos pha mthol lo bshags// shes bzhin rdzun smra dge slong skyon nas brjod// phra mas 'byed dang skyo sngogs bzlums kyang dbye// bud med chos ston bsnyen par ma rdzogs dang*// lhan cig chos 'don gnas ngan len ltung brjod// mi chos bla ma bden smra bshes ngor 'phya// bslab gzhi khyad gsod sa bon skye ba gcod// bdag gi ngor 'phya bsgo ba rnar gzon te// ltung byung gleng la ma thos lan gzhan 'debs// khri dang gding ba ma bsdus bting ste song*// dge slong skrod dang tho 'tsham phyis gnon byas// mal khri'i bug dbyung srog chags ldan pa'i chu// rtsar 'debs gtsug lag pha gu rim gsum lhag

/shes bzhin 'jig rkyen sar brtsigs dge slong mar// ma bskos chos ston bskos kyang nyi nub dang*// kha zas phyir ston gos btsems chos gos sbyin// don mthun lam 'grogs grur zhugs gyen mthur 'gro// dben par gcig 'dug pa dang mnyam du 'greng*// rdzun gyis sbyor bcug dus rung kha zas zos// yang yang zas za mu stegs 'dug pa'i sar// zhag gcig lhag bsdad za dang lhung bzed do// zos shing zos rjes bza' dang bca' ba za// spang zad ltung 'byung ched du rdzun gyis stob// gnang min mtshams nang logs su 'dus nas za// dus min phyed yol za dang gsog 'jog za// byin len ma byas sman bzhi kha ru mid// bsod pa zhim pa'i zas slong srog chags bcas// chur spyod nyal po byed pa'i khyim du nyal// nyer 'greng gcer bu pa la kha zas byin// dmag lta dmag sar zhag gnyis lhag par bsdad// dmag gi ru bkod byed dang dge slong rdeg /brdeg rtsom gnas ngan len gyi ltung ba 'chab// dge slong zas gcod dus min me la reg /dge 'dun las la 'dun phul phyir ldog smra// bsnyen ma rdzogs dang nub gnyis lhag par nyal// sdig lta mi gtong spangs pa'i rjes su phyogs// dge tshul bsnyil dang zang zing chos longs spyod// rung ba'i tshon min kha dog can gos gyon// rin chen dmag chas rgyan dang rol mor reg /gnang ba'i dus min khrus byed dud 'gro gsod// dge slong gzhan la 'gyod skyed gag tshil dgag /chur rtse bud med gnas gcig nyal ba dang*// dge slong dngangs byed de yi yo byad sbed// sngar byin gding med slar blangs spyod pa dang*// gzhi med skur btab grogs med bud med dang*// rkun po dang 'grogs rgyang grags gcig tu phyin// nyi shu ma lon pa la bsnyen rdzogs phog /sa brko mgron sar dus las lhag par zos// slob pa khyad gsod 'thab pa'i nyan rna byed// las gral mi smra 'gro dang ma gus 'gal// chang 'thung dus min phyi dro grong du rgyu// zas bcas snga phyi khyim gsum khyim bzhi 'das// rgyal po btsun mor rtse ba'i khab tu nyal// mdo sogs 'don la da gdong shes zer dang*// rin chen khab ral khri rkang che mtho bzos// shing bal dge 'dun mal du brdal te bgos// gding g.yan ras chen chos gos tshad lhag 'chang*// spyad na ngan song ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa// dgu bcu tham pas gos pa mthol lo bshags// dge slong ma las grong du zas blangs zos// khyim du ngos mgron zas sbyin ma bzlog dang*// bslab sdom byin las rung ba min pa blangs// nags ma myul bar dgon par blangs zos bzhi// so sor smre sngags 'gyod bcas mthol lo bshags// sham thabs zlum min rtsengs 'jol glang sna 'dra// lteb dang 'phur ma gdengs ka lta bu bdun// snam sbyar bla gos zlum por ma bgos dang*// ha cang ring thung stod gsum gos kyi bcu// lus ngag ma bsdams chos gos legs ma bgos// ca co mig g.yengs gnya' shing gang tsam las// ring lta mgo btums gos brdzes phrag la gzar// lag pa gnya' gong bsnol dang ltag par bsnol// mchong rgyang rkang pa'i brang dang rting btsugs 'gro// lag pa dkur brten lus bsgyur lag pa g.yobs// mgo bsgyur phrag pa sprad dang lag pa sbrel// khyim 'gro'i spyod yul nyi shur 'gal ba dang*// stan la ma bsgos ma brtags 'phongs rdeb 'dug

/rkang brkyangs bsnol dang brla bsnol long bu brtsegs// khri 'og rkang dgug rkang pa phan tshun gdangs// 'doms mthong 'dug tshul spang bya dgu po dang*// lag pas 'gram brten stan khar song ba dang*// legs par mi len kha da chad du len// zan dang bya na mnyam par mi len dang*// mthar chags mi len lhung bzed zur mig lta// bzed sngas sngar byung sbas nas bzed pa dang*// snod gzhan steng bzed zas blangs skyon brgyad dang*// legs par mi bza' ha cang kham che chung*// ran min zas las sngon du kha gdangs dang*// kha zas za bzhin tshig smra tsug gtsug dang*// cag cag hu hu phu phu lce phyung za// 'bru nas gud phye zas la skyon 'phya dang*// kham gcig mkhur spo rkan tog kham 'phro bcad// lag bldag snod 'byog lag sbrug skyom skyom byed// mchod rten 'drar byed bza' ba'i skyon nyer gcig /lhung bzed 'phyas btags lag pa zas 'bags pas// chu snod la reg 'bags chu gzhan la gtor// ma dris khyim du chu dor zas lhag bzhag /sa rjen gad ka ri gzar bang rim bzhir// bzhag 'dril gad g.yang bkan gzar langs bzhin 'khru// 'bab chu'i rgyun las bzlog ste 'khru dang gcu// lhung bzed spyod nyes la brten bcu bzhi dang*// 'grengs dang nyal la chos bshad rang nyid dma'// mdun la rgyab dang lam po'i 'gram nas bshad// mgo g.yogs brjes gzar lag pa gnya' ltag bsnol// do ker can dang zhwa gyon cod pan btags// phreng bas lus brgyan mgo dkris glang rta zhon// khyogs dang bzhon pa'i steng 'dug mchil lh+wam gyon// 'khar ba gdugs mtshon ral gri dgra cha thogs// go cha gyon la chos bshad nyes nyer drug /mi na bzhin tu 'greng ste bshang gci dor// chu nang bshang gci skyags pa mchil snabs 'phangs// rtswa sngon bshang gci dor bcas bsgrub tshul gsum// gnod med shing la mi gang lhag par 'dzeg /rgyu ba gcig ste gang sbyang nyes byas nyid// brgya dang bcu gsum las 'das mthol lo bshags// spyad na ngan 'gror ltung ba'i sde lnga pos// byang grol bar chad mi 'dod sdig ltas nyams// pham pa gang rung byung bas tshul khrims nyams// bcas ltung spong ba'i lus ngag bya ba nyams// tshul 'chos kha gsag gzhog slong rnyed 'tshol dang*// thob 'jal log 'tsho lngar spyad 'tsho ba nyams// nyams pa rnam bzhis gos pa mthol lo bshags// grong du 'jug tshe btson rwa'i 'du shes dang*// gtsug lag khang du mdo sde bzhin spyod dang*// zas la nad kyi gnyen dang 'jig rten gyi// mthun 'jug bya bar 'on long lkug pa'i tshul// nyal tshe lus sems ma 'phyar thum 'phrad kyi// 'du shes lnga po mi ldan mthol lo bshags// lus ni 'du 'dzi sems ni rnam g.yeng las// bsring ba gnyis ldan 'dod chung chog shes pas// sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas kyang*// spang dang klog par ma brtson mthol lo bshags// mtshams nang gso sbyong ma 'dus 'dun yongs dag

/ma blangs ma phul ltung ba shes bzhin bcab// so thar gus pas ma mnyan thos sgom dang*/ srog chags gnod spong phyir du dbyar zla gsum// gnas ma bcas sogs bslab pa yongs sbyong gi /gzhi gsum dag dang gang 'gal mthol lo bshags// phyag dar khrod dang dur khrod dor ba'i gos// tshad ldan 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum po// chos kyi rgyal mtshan spangs nas mi rung ba'i// rgyur byas tshon chen brgyad kyis bgos pa yi// khyim pa'i rtags blangs dus rung thun tshod rung*// zhag bdun 'tsho bcang sman bzhi rang dus las// 'das 'chang bza' btung rung ba'i chu ma btab// lag nyar blangs shing sgog btsong ltor zos nas// gtsug lag khang du phyin sogs bder gnas pa'i// rkyen gyi gzhi dang gang 'gal mthol lo bshags// gos sman rang sngags byin gyis ma brlabs sogs// gsol rkyang gsol ba dang gnyis dang bzhi yi// las la ma zhugs yan lag ma tshang dang*// ltung ba phyir bcos ma byas btang snyoms lus// rtsod gzhi'i gzhi bting chos min phyogs su bltas// cho ga khyad 'brel nyes pa dag byed kyi// gzhi gnyis po dang gang 'gal mthol lo bshags// gnas mal la sogs zhum dang khengs pa yi// mtha' gnyis spangs nas legs par ma spyod dang*// khrims dag thos sgom ma nus le lo can// dkor la bu lon tshul du spyod byas dang*// tshul mal nam yang dge 'dun gnas dang dkor// til 'bru tsam yang spyad par bkag bzhin du// bag med ci dgar longs spyad mthol lo bshags// tshong khe zhing las shags dang rgyan po 'gyed// 'dus la lta dang 'khrig pa'i gtam gleng sogs// tshangs spyod bar chad gnas grogs spangs nas ni// dran dang shes bzhin ma bsten mthol lo bshags// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag zag bcas ni// sdug bsngal chos rnams stong zhing bdag med pa// myang 'das zhi ba lta ba bka' rtags kyi// phyag rgya bzhi po ma 'dzin mthol lo bshags// dzi lar chu sbyin 'phrog mar changs bu dang*// 'bar ma 'jur gegs can la gtor ma dang*// chab sbyin ma bstsal spyod pa bka' rtags kyi// phyag rgya bzhi dang mi ldan mthol lo bshags// khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin tu// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs// gang zhig ston pa thugs rje'i bstan pa la// yang bar sems shing cung zad 'da' byed pa// de ni de las sdug bsngal gzhan dpang thob// smig tshal bregs pa mra'i tshal nyams bzhin// bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du// dang ba'i sems kyis zas dang skom rnams dang*// gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i phreng ba yis// sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gro byas// gang zhig dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang*// bde gshegs bstan pa 'gag par gyur pa'i tshe// nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa'i// bsod nams 'di ni de bas khyad par 'phags// rgyal bas sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// gtong dang tshul khrims lha rjes dran pa drug

/rab tu bka' stsal de dag so so yi// yon tan tshogs kyi rjes su dran par bgyid/ ༈ /bzod pa dka' thub dam pa bzod pa ni// mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs// rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang*// gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no// mig ldan 'gro ba yod pa yis// nyam nga ba dag ji bzhin du// mkhas pas 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten 'dir// sdig pa dag ni yongs su spang*// skur pa mi gdab gnod mi bya// so sor thar pa'ang bsdam par bya// zas kyi tshod kyang rig par bya// bas mtha'i gnas su gnas par bya// lhag pa'i sems la yang dag sbyor// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// ji ltar bung ba me tog las// kha dog dri la mi gnod par// khu ba gzhibs nas 'phur ba ltar// de bzhin thub pa grong du rgyu// bdag gi rigs dang mi rigs la// brtag par bya ste gzhan rnams kyi// mi mthun pa dang gzhan dag gi /byas dang ma byas rnams la min// lhag pa'i sems la bag bya zhing*// thub pa'i thub gzhi rnams la bslab// nyer zhi rtag tu dran ldan pa'i// skyob pa mya ngan med pa yin// sbyin pas bsod nams rab tu 'phel// legs bsdams dgra sogs mi 'byung ngo*// dge dang ldan pas sdig pa spong*// nyon mongs zad pas mya ngan 'das// sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// lus kyi sdom pa legs pa na// ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin// yid kyi sdom pa legs pa na// thams cad du ni sdom pa legs// thams cad srung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las rab tu grol// ngag rnams bsrung zhing yid kyang rab bsdam ste// lus kyi mi dge ba dag mi byed cing*// las lam gsum po 'di la rab sbyangs nas// drang srong gsungs pa'i lam ni thob par shog /brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya// sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya// 'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin// 'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya// bdag dang sems can kun gyi sdig pa'i las// nyes par gyur gang mthol zhing bshags par bgyi// slan chad nam yang bgyid par ma gyur cig

/las kyi sgrib pa'ang gtan du zad byed shog /khrims kyis tshul khrims skyon med cing*// tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan// rloms sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis// tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te// bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*// tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag par// rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi gso sbyong gi tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ so thar sdom pa'i nyes ltung mthol bshags/ zhar byung bslab bya'i gnad rtogs par 'gyur ba 'di bzhin te/ bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen zla bzang mchog sprul rin po che'i bka' bstsal ltar 'du gsum pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang dben du bris pa bstan dang 'gro la yun ring sman par gyur cig/ ༈ /shing rta chen po gnyis kyi bka' srol dang 'brel ba'i byang sdom nyes bshags nor bu ke ta ka'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kun// chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis bdag phyag 'tshal// byang chub sems kyi gzhi rnams dang*// mchod rten rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// mkhan po de bzhin slob dpon dang*// brtul zhugs mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag

/bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems// thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la// thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas// tshe rabs 'di'am gzhan dag tu// bdag gis ma 'tshal sdig bgyis pa'am// bgyid du stsal ba nyid dang ni// gti mug 'khrul pas bdag non te// rjes su yi rangs gang bgyis pa// nongs pa de ni mthong bgyis nas// bsam pa thag pas mgon la bshags// srid spong zhi la chags pa'i mtha' gnyis su// mi gnas bla na med pa'i myang 'das rgyu// theg mchog chen po bdun ldan sgor zhugs nas// byang chub spyod pa ma spyad mthol lo bshags// dge ba'i bshes spangs rigs dang dge rtsa bcad// theg chen sde snod mang thos rgyang bsrings te// grogs rgyud dge rtsa thos pa'i stobs lnga yis// sems mchog nan tan ma bskyed mthol lo bshags// thos la mi dad bsam g.yel sgom pa lhod// le lo che zhing sems can ma dad spyod// snying rje chung zhing byed spyod phyin ci log /don gnyis nyams pa'i rgyu bdun spyod pa bshags// phan yon nyes dmigs rnyed dka' ma dran dang*// yan lag bdun dang rgyal ba sras bcas la// gsol 'debs smon lam dus gsum ma bgyis dang*// chos dang 'gal ba'i bdud las ma spangs pas// 'di phyir nyams pa'i rgyur gyur mthol lo bshags// sems can rang dang dam chos nor las gces// bshes gnyen pha ma byang sems snying las gces// sangs rgyas go 'phang 'tsho ba'i longs spyod las// gces par ma bltas mthun rkyen spangs pa bshags// spangs rtogs phrin las phun tshogs thob pa'i rgyu// rang gzhan smin byed nyes spyod sdom pa dang*// dge ba chos sdud sems can don byed kyi// tshul khrims gsum dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ ༈ /nam snying thabs la mkhas sogs mdo sde'i don// 'jam dpal gdams ngag 'phags zhabs yab sras las// rim 'ongs zab mo lta brgyud bzhed gzhung gi

/bslab pa'i gnas dang gang 'gal mthol lo bshags// gzhan don rdzogs byang don gnyis blos btang nas// theg dman rang don nyi tshe yid la byed// phas pham las lci tshul khrims skyon byed pa// sdom pa'i rtsa ba smon sems gtong ba bshags// byang chub sems 'dor ser snas sbyin mi byed// mi bzod khro bas rdeg cing nyon mongs dang*// gnas mthun chos ltar bcos pa bstan la sogs// 'jug pas dge la ma sbyor mthol lo bshags// sku gzugs mchod rten dam chos glegs bam dang*// chos smra'i cha rkyen dge 'dun 'du ba'i rdzas// dkon mchog dkor la rku 'phrog longs spyad pas// rtsa ltung dang pos gos pa mthol lo bshags// theg gsum gang yang rung ba'i sde snod dang*// tshul khrims ting 'dzin sems kyi bslab pa la// rang 'dod blo yis phyogs khyer smad cing spangs// rtsa ltung gnyis pas gos pa mthol lo bshags// rab byung rtags tsam 'dzin pa yan chad la// sdang bas gos 'phrogs brdegs shing btson du bcug /khyim sar phab dang bsad dam gsod sems 'chang*// rtsa ltung gsum pas gos pa mthol lo bshags// dge 'dun dbyen byed pha ma dgra bcom gsod// de bzhin gshegs la ngan sems khrag phyung ba// mtshams med lnga las gang rung gcig spyad de// rtsa ltung bzhi pas gos pa mthol lo bshags// las 'bras khyad gsod log ltas mi dge spyod// dge rtsa chad pa'i rtsa ltung lnga pas gos// byang sems rgyal la 'byung nye'i ltung ba lnga// byas sam byed du bcug pa mthol lo bshags// khyim nyung grong dang rigs bzhi tshang ba'i ljongs// grong khyer grong rdal yul 'khor chen po rnams// sdang bas 'jigs pas 'joms sogs blon po la// 'byung nye'i rtsa ltung lnga po gos pa bshags// dang po'i las can blo ma sbyangs pa la// ma brtags stong nyid brjod sngas nyan thos smon// sangs rgyas sgrub la zhugs pa'i blo chen po// de las bzlog ste theg dman lam du bkod// nyan thos rigs can so thar slob pa la// smad nas dor te theg chen slob tu bcug

/nyan thos theg pas chags sogs mi spong bas// mthar lam med smra gzhan la'ang 'dzin du 'jug /phrag dog dbang gis byang sems gzhan gyi skyon// yod med kun gleng rang gi yon tan ngoms// ma rtogs bzhin du brnyed dang bkur sti'i phyir// rtogs par khas 'che bdag nyid log par 'tshong*// rgyal dang dbyen byas dge sbyor chad 'bebs shing*// chad 'jal lkog brngan dkon mchog dkor nor blangs// zhi gnas la sogs rnal 'byor 'dor 'jug cing*// spong ba'i longs spyod klog pa'i sde la byin// dang po'i las can pha yal 'byung nges shing*// mi bzad sems can dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu// dge rtsa sngon bskyed thal bar rlag byed pa// rtsa ltung brgyad pos gos pa mthol lo bshags// bde sdug yal bar 'dor ba nyi shu bzhi// bsgrub pa yal bar 'dor ba bcu drug bcas// gnas skabs su'am gtan du dor ba yi// yan lag nyes byas brgyad cus gos pa bshags// mi dge bcu dang chos brgyad log 'tsho lnga// log rtog brgyad dang spyod yul min pa lnga// sdig grogs sdig lta 'dzin sogs bdud kyi las// lta bas gzings dang dge rtsa mdzad pa'i rgyu// bzhi sogs theg chen mdo las gsungs rnams dang*// don med rgyug mchong bre mo'i gtam smra zhing*// chags sdang mno sogs dgag pa'i bslab bya nyams// 'dzum des zhi dal drang por ma smras sogs// bsgrub pa'i bslab bya rnams dang 'gal ba bshags/ ༈ /'khor lo phyi ma gnyis kyis bstan pa'i don// byams mgon gdams ngag thog med sku mched las// rim 'ongs rgya chen spyod brgyud bzhed gzhung gi /bslab pa'i gnas dang gang 'gal mthol lo bshags// phan btags lan du gnod pa cher byas kyang*// yang lan snying rje chen pos mi ldon par// sems can gcig la skad cig gcig tsam du// khro bas blo yis btang ba mthol lo bshags// sdong po bkod par nyis brgya sum cu'i dpes// bstan sogs smon sems bskyed pa'i phan yon ni// dngos por grub na nam mkhar mi shong ba// rtag tu dran te gces spras ma byas bshags// thun tshod rer yang gzhan phan 'ba' zhig blos// chos spyod rnam bcu bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi// phar phyin bcu sogs byang sems stobs bskyed pa'i// tshogs gnyis zung 'jug ma bsags mthol lo bshags// byams dang snying rje rgyu la ma sbyangs dang*// nyin mtshan dus drug byang sems ma blangs dang*// bde sdug gtong len spyod la ma sbyangs sogs// byang sems 'phel ba'i thabs la ma brtson bshags// mchod 'os bslu zhing gzhan la 'gyod pa bskyed// dge sbyong skyon brjod 'gro la g.yo sgyus spyod// byas pa tsam gyis sdom pa 'jig byed pa// nag po'i chos bzhis gos pa mthol lo bshags// srog gi phyir yang shes bzhin rdzun mi smra// sems bskyed pa la ston pa'i 'du shes bzhag

/'gro la g.yo med kun kyang theg pa cher// 'god 'dod dkar po'i chos bzhi mi ldan bshags// rnyed dang bkur sti lhag par chags pa'i blos// bdag la bstod cing gzhan gyi yon tan smod// sdug bsngal mgon med pa dang snod gyur la// ser snas zang zing nor dang chos mi ster// gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi bzad khro ba yis// zhe 'khon mi ldog rdeg cing 'tshog pas 'tshe// gti mug dbang gis chos la skur 'debs shing*// chos ma yin pa chos ltar bcos te 'chad// 'jug pa'i bslab bya dang 'gal rtsa ltung bzhi// nyon mongs che 'bring chung dus spyad pa las// sdom pa shor dang nyams 'gal gyur pa yis// sa lam ring du byas pa mthol lo bshags// dkon mchog mi mchod 'dod sems rjes su zhugs// rgan la ma gus dris la lan mi 'debs// mgron pos ma song gser sogs sbyin mi lan// chos 'dod mi ster sbyin dang 'gal ba bdun// tshul 'chal yal 'dor dad phyir rang mi slob// gzhan don mi byed spang bdun phan yang 'dzem// log 'tsho dang len 'phyar g.yeng rtsed mor dga'// srid 'byor la chags gzhan grags ngan mi sel// rang gzhan nyon mongs che ldan mthong na yang*/ chos bzhin mi sel tshul khrims dang 'gal dgu// gshe khro rdeg dang mtshang 'brur de lan zlog /gzhan khros sems gso ma byas yal bar dor// bshags pa ma blangs khro ba'i sems byung na// ma spangs dang blangs bzod dang 'gal ba bzhi// nor dang snyan grags ched du 'khor bsdus shing*// gnyid dang snyom las le lo sel mi byed// 'du 'dzi'i gtam chags brtson 'grus 'gal zla gsum// sems gnas thabs bor sgrib pa lnga mi spong*/ bde gsal ror chags bsam gtan dang 'gal gsum// theg dman mi slob theg chen sde snod dor// sangs rgyas gzhung dor mu stegs bstan bcos brtson// nang rig las kyang phyi gzhung ched cher gzung*// theg chen skur 'debs bdag bstod gzhan la smod// chos smra'i drung du chos phyir mi 'gro bar// 'phya zhing khyad gsod shes rab dang 'gal brgyad// gzhan gyi grogs ngan nad pa'i rim gro dang*// sdug bsngal bsal zhing bag med tshul bzhin du// 'chos par mi byed gzhan don las nyams bzhi// phan btags lan du drin gzo ma byas dang*// mya ngan ma bsal slong la 'dod ma byin// 'khor rnams ma bskyangs gzhan sems dang mi mthun// gzhan bsngags mi brjod phan 'dogs g.yel ba drug

/chos 'gal chad pa 'os kyang btang snyoms bzhag /chos ldan gtam dang rdzu 'phrul gyis ma bsdigs// ngan pa tshar mi gcod pa'i nyes gnyis bcas// nyes byas bzhi bcu rtsa drug spyad pa bshags// gzhan yang so sor thar pa ris brgyad kyi// bcas ltung blangs 'das kun rtsa skyabs sdom dang*// 'gal sogs ma gus snyom las le lo yis// nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul dang gang 'gal bshags// mi mthun phyogs nyams mi rtog ye shes ldan// 'dod don rdzogs shing sems can rab smin byed// khyad chos bzhi ldan phar phyin so drug sogs// dge chos mtha' dag ma bsdus mthol lo bshags// zang zing dam chos mi 'jigs ma byin dang*// sdom dang chos sdud don byed tshul khrims nyams// gnod dang sdug bsngal zab mo'i don mi bzod// go cha dge sdud gzhan phan brtson 'grus lhod// bder gnas sgrub dang gzhan don bsam gtan g.yel// thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab ma goms te// yon tan bzhi dang ldan pa'i pha rol phyin// dam pa drug ldan nyams su ma blangs bshags// dus gsum gyis bsdus sems can smin byed thabs// kun 'dus sbyin dang snyan smra don spyod dang*// don mthun dngos po bzhi yis sems can gyi// don byed tshul khrims ma bsrungs mthol lo bshags// lus dang longs spyod dge ba'i dngos gsum po// bsrung dang dag pa gtong dang spel ba yi// sa mtshams bzhin du mthun phyogs kun slob cing*// mi mthun phyogs spang ji bzhin ma byas bshags// mdor na dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas// 'di dang gtan du phan pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// rgyal sras rnams kyi bslab bya gang yin pa// mig dang srog ltar ma bsrungs mthol lo bshags// gang gis rigs dang mi rigs ma brtags par// rtsom mam ldog gam btang snyoms 'jog kyang rung*// 'od 'das ltung dang ltung med gzugs brnyan sogs// byang sems bslab pa'i gnas dang gang 'gal bshags// nyes pa dus mas skyon chags pa'i// sdig can bdag gis sdig pa gang*// shin tu mi bzad bgyis pa de// thams cad 'dren pa rnams la bshags// bdag ni sdig pa ma byang bar// sngon du 'gum par 'gyur du mchi// ji ltar 'di la nges thar bar// myur ba'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol// spro na 'dir/

de bas rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// sogs tshang bar brjod/ ltung nyid byang chub sems rang bzhin// las med rnam par smin pa med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// sems can kun gyi ngan song gi /sdug bsngal ngal gso'i dge ba dang*// sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nges par thar la yi rang ngo*// skyob pa rnams kyi byang chub dang*// rgyal sras sa la'ang yi rang ngo*// sems can thams cad bde mdzad pa'i// thugs bskyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang*// sems can phan par mdzad pa la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thoms la// chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol// rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// 'gro 'di ldongs par mi 'god cing*// bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad byed cing*// byang chub bla med la yang dad par bgyi// rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la rab dad pas// bla med byang chub sems mchog rtag tu gzung*// 'dus byas g.yo ba sdug bsngal mtha' la rtog /ston pa'i che ba chos dang byang sems kyi// phan yon dran pa lnga po rtag tu bsten// brtson 'grus rtar zhon shes bzhin mig gis blta// nges 'byung lcag bskul thar pa'i grong khyer la// bsam ste mi dge kun spong dge chos bsgrub// dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed par shin tu dka'// skyes bu'i don sgrub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na// phyis 'di yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur// dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni// 'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*// 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rwar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de// skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing*// gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi// ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// sogs lan gsum/

mgon po rnams kyi spyan snga ru// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed cing*// 'gro ba thams cad mgron du gnyer// de dag 'khor ba las bsgral te// gnod sems khro ba'i sems nyid dang*// ser sna dang ni phrag dog nyid// deng nas bzung ste byang chub mchog /thob kyi bar du mi bya'o// tshangs par spyod pa sbyang bya zhing*// sdig dang 'dod pa spang bar bya// tshul khrims sdom pa la dga' bas// sangs rgyas rjes su bslab par bya// bdag nyid myur ba'i tshul gyis ni// byang chub thob par mi spro zhing*// sems can gcig gi phyir yang ni// phyi ma'i mu mthar gnas par bgyi// tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// zhing dag rnam par sbyang bar bya// ming nas bzung bar byas pa dang*// phyogs bcu dag tu rnam par gnas// bdag gi lus dang ngag gi las// thams cad du ni dag par bya// yid kyi las kyang dag bya ste// mi dge'i las rnams mi bya'o// bdag gis byang chub spyod pa la// 'jug pa rnam par brtsams pa yi// dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun// byang chub spyod la 'jug par shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar thug par// sogs dang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu// sogs shlo ka re re/ dpe med pa yi sems skyes nas// skad cig rer yang bskal mang gi /tshogs bzlums mtha' la mi gnas pa'i// rnam thar chos kyi dbyings khyab shog /gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba yi// sogs shlo ka gcig 'jam dpal dpa' bos sogs/ ji ltar sngon gyi sogs/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*// chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji btab bsngo ba smon lam 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di'ang grub brnyes dkon mchog bstan 'dzin mchog gi sprul pa'i sku chen po/ karma bstan 'dzin dge legs nyi ma'i zhal snga nas bka' stsal phebs pa lhur blangs te/

byams mgon gnyis pa'i 'bangs tha blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spung yang khrod du bris pa 'brel pa thogs tshad spyan ras gzigs dbang dang mnyam par gyur cig/ ༈ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gi nyes ltung bshags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i khrus chu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ho/ chos dbyings nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi// lhun grub dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams dang*// sems dpa'i rdo rje sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas// dam tshig rjes gcod dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// chos skyong dpal mgon dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// thugs dam dbang gis mos pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs// rnal 'byor nyams pa can la thugs rjes dgongs// rdo rje'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol bshags na// bzod par bzhes la tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// bdag dang mkha' mnyam mar gyur 'gro ba kun// zhing rdul grangs snyed sgo gsum gus btud nas// phyag 'tshal byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// thog med nas bsags sdig sgrib nyes ltung tshogs// bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba// khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i 'dul ba las// 'gal nyams ral bar gyur pa gang mchis pa// gnong 'gyod drag pos snying nas mthol zhing bshags// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la// mnyes pa dgu yis tshul bzhin ma bsten cing*// mthun rkyen ma bsgrubs dbang gis rgyud ma smin// ras chod dbang gis gsang ba'i theg par zhugs// rgyud don ma khrol man ngag gnad la rmongs// bsrung mtshams ma shes shes kyang le los g.yengs// thog ma'i rten 'brel log pa mthol lo bshags/ ༈ /bsrung bya kun gyi gzhir gyur 'jig rten pa'i// yang dag lta 'dzin gsum la skyabs su 'gro// byang chub sems bskyed dkyil 'khor dbang bskur ba// ji bzhin lag tu ma blangs mthol lo bshags// rgyud sde kun gyi gzhi'am rtsa ba ni// bya rgyud spyi yi dam tshig mtha' dag dang*// bye brag spyi rgyud nas gsungs bcu bzhi po// dkon mchog sngags la dad dang theg chen mos// zhing mchog la gus mi sdang dus mtshams mchod// gzhan gzhung mi bkur mgron mchod byams sems brtan// bsod nams bzlas pa dam tshig gzhan bsrung brtson// dam med sngags rgya mi sbyin rgyud sba zhing*// thos bsam bsgoms pas ma rtogs mthol lo bshags// gzhan yang legs grub nas bshad sum cu po// dkon mchog sngags dang theg pa che la mos// lha la dus mtshams mgron la glo bu mchod// bsod nams tshogs bsags bzlas brjod tshul bzhin brtson// spyi dang bye brag rigs kyi dam tshig brtan// rgyud srung rtogs dang sgo gsum nye bar zhi// khrus dang gtsang sbra bsgrub phyogs bcu gnyis dang*// lha la mi sdang gzhan gyi gzhung mi mchod// ma gnang mi len gsang sngags rang bzor min// gdon gyi las min las sgrub gzhan mi bsgyur// dam med mi sbyin phyag rgya sogs mi 'gong*// ma bsdams pa min ma gnang zas mi za// byams pa mi gtong ma zin smra ba min// khros nas drag shul mi spyod bdag mi brnyes// gzhan sun mi 'byin gnas ngan len rnams spong*// ltad mo mi lta bshang gci chur mi dor// bco brgyad dgag pa'i sgo nas gsum rnams dang*// so so'i rigs kyi dam tshig ji snyed pa// rgyud 'dir zhugs pa ma zad bla med kyi// rnal 'byor pas kyang bsrung bya yin pa la// spang blang go ldog gyur pa mthol lo bshags// spyod rgyud mi dge bcu dang dam pa'i chos// byang chub sems spong ser snas 'gro la gnod// spang bya bcu bzhi rigs kyi dam tshig sogs// bsgrub bya rnams las 'gal ba mthol lo bshags// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam tshig bshad rgyud lugs// rnam snang rigs la dkon mchog gsum po bkur// rdo rje'i rigs la rdo dril slob dpon gzung*// rin chen rigs la sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin// padma'i rigs la phyi gsang theg pa gzung*// las kyi rigs la mchod par brtson pa ste// bsgrub phyogs bcu bzhi ma bsten mthol lo bshags// dkon mchog byang chub sems par lha sngags rgya// bla mar smad cing nyer spyod phyag mtshan 'god// bza' ba mi spyod gsang bsgrag bslab pa dor// 'tshe zhing theg dman la dga' gzhan don skyo// phyin drug spyod dor bya min bya ba ste// dgag phyogs bcu bzhi bgyis pa mthol lo bshags// rtsa rgyud nas gsungs lha lnga'i dam tshig dang*// dpal mchog dang pos bstan pa'i rtsa ltung bcu// rtsa ba byang sems pham pa bcu bzhi dang*// yan lag tshul khrims gsum ste rigs lnga spyi// mdor bsdus bsgrags te gzung ba las 'gal zhing*// phyir bcos tshul bzhin ma bgyis mthol lo bshags// gsang ba bla med sgor zhugs rnal 'byor pas// thog mar blang bya rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni// sha chen bshang gci khu khrag bdud rtsi lnga// srog gcod rdzun smra 'dod spyod nor la chags// dngos sbas dgongs te gsungs rnams rgyu tshogs tsam// ma bsten 'dus pa'i rgyud dang 'gal ba bshags// bde mchog nas gsungs tshangs spyod nyi shu gnyis// tshes bcur rigs ldan ma dang phyi rol mchod// lag mchod rdo rje bzhi yi nges don mchod// phyag rgya bzhi bsten dpa' bo dpa' mo mchod// brda dang g.yon pa'i kun spyod ma bgyis dang*// rmongs pas bgrod cing rang gzhan tha dad 'dzin// gus pa lhod cing phyag rgya mi bsten 'bral// spyod pa nyams shing dam tshig rdzas la khro// pho nya gsum gyi sgrub pa la gnas pa'i// rig ma'i brtul zhugs thun mong thun min rnams// ma bsten log par bsgrub pa mthol lo bshags// dkon mchog mi spong dam tshig rnams la spyad// rdo rje dril bu glegs bam gtsug tu bcangs// sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor rab gnas las la brtson// 'byung por gtor ma sbyin cing bzlas sgom 'bad// slob mar chos bshad sems can byams pas bsdu/

rgyal la tshogs bsag dzaṃ lar chu sbyin gtang*// mchod rten sātstsha dge ba'i las bya zhes// las dang po yi bsgrub bya bcu bzhi po// gur las gsungs rnams ma bgyis mthol lo bshags// rgyun gyi bya ba mchod pa'i de nyid dang*// sba gsang pho nya sngags bzlas zhing la gus// spyod brtul klog pa thos bsam sgom byin rlabs// mngon brjod bla ma nas gsungs spyod pa dgu// tshul bzhin ma rtogs ma bsgrubs mthol lo bshags// rtsa bzhi chang bcas bsrung bya rnam pa lnga// rgyan po bza' min ngan tshig 'byung po dang*// kla klo'i chos te bya ba min pa lnga// dud 'gro byis pa skyes pa pho dang mo// dkon mchog mchod rten bsnun pa min pa lnga// grogs po rje dpon sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang*// yid rton bla mar 'khu ba min pa lnga// gzugs sgra dri ro reg byar zhen min lnga// rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs nyer lnga po// dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud kyi rgyal po las// gsungs rnams ji bzhin ma bsgrubs mthol lo bshags// sgo gsum bag chags dang bcas rdo rje bzhir// thabs shes khyad par can gyi sdom pa'i khrims// mi bskyod phyag rgya gsum gzung bla ma bsten// rin chen rigs la sbyin pa rnam bcu sbyin// 'khor lor sha lnga bdud rtsi'i chos mthun bza'// ral grir mchod cing padmar 'pho med bsrung*// rdor sems byang chub sems te drang nges tshul// rim gnyis don dang ldan par bsdebs pa las// ye shes gong du ma spel mthol lo bshags// khyad par rdo rje'i rigs la srog gcod cing*// ral grir brdzun smra rin chen gzhan nor len// chu skyes bud med 'phrog cing 'khor lo la// sha chang longs spyod gri gug shes rab mar// mi smad gtong ba che rnams rgyud tshod bzhin// dngos dang bsam pas sgra don ji bzhin dang*// ji bzhin min la ma spyad mthol lo bshags// dam pa'i tshig las nam yang 'dar med pa// bsrungs na dngos grub ma bsrungs ngan song du// ltung ba'i rtsa ba shin tu lci ba'i khrims// dbang rgyud man ngag ye shes don ston pa'i// dpal ldan bla mar brnyes shing thugs dkrugs dang*// rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i gsungs las 'das// nye ring rdo rje'i spun la khros shing smad// byams pa'i sems btang kunda byang sems spangs// grub pa'i mthar smod ma smin gsang ba sbyin// phung por brnyes shing dag pa'i chos la tshom// g.yo sgyu'i dbang gyur gdug pa can la byams// ming sogs phral la der rtog yid gnyis za// dad ldan dag pa'i sems can sun 'byin cing*// khyad par dus su bsten bya'i dam tshig 'dor// bud med spyir smod rtsa ltung bcu bzhi po// yul bsam sbyor dus nyes pa lan grangs te// sgo drug dbye bas brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang*// de yang lci 'bring yang ba'i bye brag gis// nyis brgya nga gnyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i khrims// phra rags sgo nas 'gal ba mthol lo bshags// dam med mtshan nyid mi ldan rig ma bsten// sngags spyod la rtsod yul min bdud rtsi len// dus la mi bshad dris lan bre mos gdab// nyan thos nang 'dug mi shes sngags par rloms// dgos pa med par so byang bcas las 'da'// bsnyen sogs ma dag dkyil 'khor las la 'jug

/brda dang phyag rgya yul min la bstan cing*// snod min gsang bsgrags yan lag sbom po yi// ltung ba rnams kyis gos pa mthol lo bshags// phrin las sgrub pa la brten ltung ba'i las// me tog phog pa'i lha dor bskyed rdzogs yol// phyi rol lhar dga' bskyed rim dngos por zhen// ma thob gzhan 'chad 'dir snang zab chos ston// bslab pa 'og mar brnyes shing tshul 'chos byed// nus med las sbyor don med g.yeng bas 'da'// skyabs nus mi skyob 'og ma'i spyod la dga'// zang zing la chags dam nyams 'dul mi bya// spyod pa dus skabs ma 'brel mthol lo bshags// dam pa ma bsten snod kyi spang blang 'chol// rang 'dod phyir du srog chags gzhan la gnod// dkon mchog dkor spyad gzhan don yal bar dor// bsngo bas rgyas ma thebs shing 'pho ba yi// de nyid ma mkhas pa rnams mthol lo bshags// sngags la the tshom theg gsum rim ma bstan// de nyid bcu dang ma ldan slob dpon byas// bdud brtag mi mkhas dam tshig brtag mi byed// nyes byas chung ngu mi bshags khyad du bsad// phra mo nyer brgyad phog pa mthol lo bshags// sngags pa slong mos rgyu zhing rnal 'byor spangs// rgyun du gsang sngags ma bzlas dam tshigs sogs// rtag tu bsten par ma bgyis mthol lo bshags// dbang bzhi'i mnyam gzhag dam tshig bskyed rim dang*// rtsa rlung dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rba rlabs gsum// rjes spyod ngo bo nyid gsum rang byung dang*// sgrib gnyis khyad par shes sgrib ma spangs dang*// mi 'bral rdo rje dril bu rlung zhi drag /dngos dang ye rgya ma bsten mthol lo bshags// 'gro kun sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi// rang bzhin ma shes lus la brnyas pa dang*// ngag la sun phyung yid la zug rngu bskyed// rdo rje gsum gyi dam 'gal mthol lo bshags// 'pho med bcu drug rim pa bskyed pa dang*// 'dod pas mi bsgrod nya mthar gnyis med byed// nag po'i phyogs la mi zhugs mi mo yi// spyod pa legs srung tshangs spyod rdo rje'i zhal// 'dren pa rtsa yi kun spyod mchog dngos rgyu// khyad par brgyad dang mi ldan mthol lo bshags// mdor na bla med dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba'i// bsrung bya rtsa ba yan lag phra mor bcas// bsgrub bya bza' dang spyad dang mi 'bral ba// drod thob brtul zhugs drug dang 'gal ba sogs// gang yang mi shes bag med nyon mongs rags// ma gus brjed ngas dran pa mi gsal ba// nyams pa'i rgyu drug la brten sbyor ba bdun// tshang ba'i pham pa ma tshang sbom ltung sogs// nyes byas phra rags gang bgyis mthol lo bshags/

༈ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam dkyil 'khor rab 'byams dang*// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// dbang gyur tshad mar gyur rnams spyan lam du// bdag cag gsang ba'i sgor zhugs rnal 'byor rnams// so skye'i dbang gyur gnyen po zhan pa yis// rgyud las gsungs pa'i dam tshig phyi nang gsang*// drang nges ma phyed nyams chags 'gal gyur pa// gnod 'gyod gdung ba drag pos mthol lo bshags// bdag gis bgyis dang gzhan la bgyid du stsal// rjes su yi rangs sdig pa'i las gang dag /rnam smin mi bzad skyed pa'i rgyur gyur pa// de kun rab tu 'gyod pas mthol zhing bshags// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas// ye shes spyan la sgrib pa mi mnga' bas// bdag yid snying nas gus shing gdung ba la// mkhyen dgongs thugs rjes bzod cing tshangs par stsol// phyin chad srog gi phyir yang nyams pa'i las// mi bgyid zab mo'i lam mchog tshul bzhin bsten// de ltar bshags pas nyams chags sor chud de// bdag rgyud rnam par dag par byin gyis rlobs// byang chub sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// rim gnyis lam gyi mngon rtogs mthar phyin nas// tshe 'di nyid la khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan myur thob shog /de ma thob kyi skye ba thams cad du// rigs bzang blo ldan snying rje che ba dang*// nga rgyal med cing bla ma la gus pas// rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang bder bgrod shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan mi 'bral cing*// lag tu rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'chang*// ngag gis gsang sngags rgyal po bzla ba dang*// yid kyis zung 'jug mngon par sgom par shog /thun mongs khyad par dbang gis rgyud smin cing*// dam tshig sdom dang brtul zhugs lam kun gyi// rtsa bar shes na srog bzhin bsrung nus shing*// rmi lam du yang nyams par mi byed shog /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang 'di// sna tshogs thabs kyis phyogs bcu'i zhing du spel// lus can mtha' dag lam mchog 'di nyid kyis// sangs rgyas sa la bde blag 'god nus shog

/bya byed 'khor gsum rang bzhin mi dmigs kyang*// 'dzin rtog zad phyir dag tshangs phul ba'i dges// sgrib gnyis ngo bo gdod nas rnam dag pa'i// gnas lugs mngon gyur phyag rgya che thob shog /bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa myur thob shog /skye ba kun tu rigs bdag mi 'chol zhing*// bcom ldan drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin bzhin du// shes rab padma'i bdud rtsi 'thung byed cing*// byang chub snying por srid pa dag byed shog /ces pa 'di ni sngar byas pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi dam tshig nyes bshags kun bzang khrus chu las gsar ma kho na khol phyung du klog pa'i skabs kyi mjug mthud du/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin blo gros mtha' yas kyis spel ba dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
